verdict.rationale: vLLM documents efficient KV-cache memory management through PagedAttention and prefix caching. It also documents data parallelism and multi-LoRA, which touch on serving several models or replicas. None of the evidence shows user-facing controls for allocating context memory, or how memory is split across concurrently running instances. Missing for 10: documented user-tunable KV/context memory allocation settings, guidance on running multiple concurrent model instances on shared hardware, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
